_notes: Only OpenAI standard endpoints; decisions, rerank and video have no common format.
guide is the text of the Providers tab: how hard the setup is (level 1-4 and ease), a summary, the steps, and what is good or to watch. Shown with the signup link.
keyOptional: the model list can load and requests can go without a key (local servers such as Ollama take none). Other providers need a key, typed or on the server, before the page loads models.
label: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)

guide.summary: Any OpenAI-compatible URL: a local model server such as Ollama or LM Studio, or another provider.
steps: Start the server, e.g. Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1) or LM Studio (http://localhost:1234/v1).
Allow this page's origin if the server checks it (for Ollama, OLLAMA_ORIGINS).
Enter its base URL at the top of this page, and a key if it needs one.
good: Local models cost nothing per call and nothing leaves your machine.
watch: Only the endpoints the server really has will work. Decisions, rerank and video are off: they have no OpenAI standard.
